description: "From Jest to Earnest" by Edward Payson Roe is a novel likely written during the late 19th century. The story primarily revolves around Charlotte "Lottie" Marsden, a vivacious and beautiful young woman, and her interactions with her cousin Frank Hemstead, a soon-to-be clergyman.
